summary: Gone Spalding Bay lookout in Teton County, now in Grand Teton National Park; a 1942 item names a Forest Service lookout on duty, and no source gives a build date.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by firelookout.com and the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Wyoming list
facts.agency: Grand Teton National Park (1942 staffing was for the Forest Service)

events.note: Fred Brown on duty at the Spalding lookout for the Forest Service, per a July 30, 1942 Jackson's Hole Courier item

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1942 Jackson's Hole Courier item says the lookout was staffed for the Forest Service; firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts now place the site in Grand Teton National Park. Both are kept.

notes_for_editor: No build date and no removal date in any source read. An NPS Grand Teton history chapter (search snippet: 'Spaulding Bay fire lookout, built c. 1940') could not be used: the cache returns an unrelated NPS page for that URL, so the c. 1940 date is not cited and should be checked by hand. Willhite Spalding Bay page URL not located (guessed URL 404). Guessed firetower.org registry URL returned 404. Two web searches used. Only one dated staffing item was found. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story text was checked claim by claim and needed no change; evidence entries were added for the Teton County, Sunday-guest and Wyoming list type claims.
